title: se-implementation-scratchpad-crescent-national-bank
content:
Daily scratchpad for Crescent National Bank (CNB) implementation - working notes and action items.

Context:
- Customer: Crescent National Bank (regional bank, heavy compliance)
- Engagement: Private deployment (VPC), dedicated capacity pilot for core chat/transaction assistant
- Primary contacts: Laura Gomez (IT), Mark Chu (Platform)

High-level goals:
- Stand up Private deployment in CNB AWS account w/ VPC peering and KMS integration
- Provide RBAC + audit logs, meet SOC2-like controls requested
- Baseline latency < 120ms p50 for small chat model (seq len 256), throughput 60 req/s

Current status (quick):
- VPC design drafted, waiting on CNB network team to approve subnet CIDR ranges (ticket JIRA-RDW-7890)
- EKS cluster + nodegroups template working locally; need to bake final IAM roles
- Model choice: small-medium Llama2-13B quantized (q4_0) for latency/cost balance - confirm with customer on quality
- KV cache plan: enable prefix caching for common customer intents (account-balance, transaction-status)

Immediate TODOs (priority ordered):
1) Network: follow up with CNB network on peering window and route table updates. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-05.
2) IAM: create least-privilege IAM role for Redwood agent in customer account (temp creds flow documented). Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-03-02 (blocked - need CNB security ok).
3) KMS: validate CMK policy for Redwood service principal; get key alias from CNB (todo: Laura). Owner: Ravi. Due: 2026-03-04.
4) Model & perf: run perf job with q4_0 Llama2-13B on 8xA100 sim node to verify 120ms p50 for 256 seq. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-06.
5) Rollout plan: draft canary policy (5% traffic -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic fallback to hosted model if dedicated fails. Owner: Product. Due: 2026-03-09.

Notes / quick config snippets:
- VPC peering notes: use gw-attachment approach, two private subnets per AZ, peering route table must allow 10.10.0.0/16 -> 172.31.0.0/16 (CNB <-> Redwood). Confirm CNB does not have overlapping ranges.
- IAM minimal: sts:AssumeRole, kms:Decrypt (CMK key id), ec2:DescribeInstances (for ops), s3:GetObject (for model artifacts), logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents.
- KMS policy snippet (note to self): include condition aws:SourceAccount = CNB account id and aws:SourceArn = arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/redwood-agent. (double-check syntax with security)
- Model config (redwood.yaml snippet): model_name: llama2-13b-q4_0
  max_seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache: enabled
  batching: dynamic
  quant_profile: q4_0

Testing checklist (manual + automated):
- End-to-end smoke: auth -> route -> model inference -> response streaming.
- Latency perf test: 10k requests sustained, p50/p90/p99. Capture token counts.
- Failover test: shut down primary node, ensure automatic fallback to hosted or second AZ in < 30s.
- Security: KMS CMK rotation test, audit log export to CNB Splunk instance.

Risks / open questions:
- CNB legal wants HSM-backed keys only (may require on-prem HSM or CloudHSM integration) -> escalated to sales + security.
- Network: customer firewall rules might block health checks from Redwood IPs; need allowlist IPs.
- Model quality: CNB requires <1% hallucination rate on finance prompts we send - need curated eval set. Who owns prompts? (Mark?)

Meeting notes (2026-02-27 sync):
- Laura: procurement will sign off next week pending KMS confirmation.
- Mark: prefers canary with time-based rollback (30m) + manual approval before 100% rollout.
- Action: provide SOW addendum for HSM if required.

Personal TODOs / reminders:
- Send CNB sample eval prompts by Friday.
- Add resilience test to CI: simulate KV cache miss storm (large fanout).
- Update internal runbook for private deployments with new IAM pattern.

Quick links (to paste into email):
- Confluence design: https://confluence.internal/redwood/cnb-private-deploy-design (CONFLUENCE-CRS-1123)
- Jira epic: https://jira.internal/browse/RDW-7890
- MR for infra: https://gitlab.com/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/452

Notes to self: keep this doc messy. Use it as working log. Move finalized runbooks into shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments when stable.

Last quick log entries:
- 2026-02-25: ran perf baseline, 150ms p50 on 8xA100 (need tuning + batching).
- 2026-02-26: CNB provided subnet info; overlaps with one of our staging ranges -> propose alternate (10.20.0.0/16).
- 2026-02-28: security asked for CMK policy draft (sent).

-- Aisha
